text: 金十数据8月30日讯，德国财政部长克林拜尔计划在美国与G20同行会谈期间，呼吁结束包括关税争端以及伊朗战争和俄乌冲突在内的、对经济造成损害的冲突。兼任德国副总理克林拜尔在下周一于北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔开始的会议前表示：“所有这些都对全球经济发展构成毒害。”他说，减少“全球范围内的巨大不确定性”是所有人的责任，而G20正是明确这一点的合适平台。克林拜尔表示，他还计划在会议期间与包括印度、加拿大和英国在内的国家同行举行会谈，寻求与那些“和我们一样依赖开放且基于规则的贸易、重视可靠性与合作”的国家加强合作。
text_en: Jinshi Data August 30 - German Finance Minister Klingbeil plans to call for an end to economically damaging conflicts, including tariff disputes, the Iran war, and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, during talks with G20 counterparts in the US. Klingbeil, who also serves as vice chancellor, said ahead of the meetings starting Monday in Asheville, North Carolina: "All of this is poison for global economic development." He said reducing "the enormous uncertainty worldwide" is everyone's responsibility, and the G20 is the right platform to make that clear. Klingbeil said he also plans bilateral talks with counterparts including India, Canada, and the UK during the meetings, seeking to strengthen cooperation with countries that "like us, rely on open and rules-based trade and value reliability and cooperation."
